areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Requalification includes a solar photovoltaic system for cost savings and supply security.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Includes individual sewage collection and treatment systems giving proper final disposal.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Social work project ensures popular participation during works via community participation, communication and environmental education.

areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Photovoltaic and sewage effects on the environment are indirect, not actions directly promoting sustainability.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Sewage system helps conserve water and soil, but no integrated water-resources management actions.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: No actions directly aimed at biodiversity or forest management; sewage benefits are indirect.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Entrepreneurship training could not be linked to concrete benefits such as easier business opening or trade.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Information insufficient; works and training not shown to generate jobs and income for vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No infrastructure or facilities specifically aimed at low-income or vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Information insufficient; youth and gender actions belong under 1.11.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Training quotas for women and youth are not an effective inclusion action compared with hiring in project works.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Better bathing-water quality reduces waterborne disease, but as an indirect impact, not a specific action.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Solar generation already credited in 1.2; panels are equipment acquisition, not technological innovation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Information in the proposal was insufficient.
